info.description: Multi-tenant URL shortener — AI-Assisted Engineering Assignment (Charles Schwab). Run the '0. Setup' request first (or the Collection Runner on the whole collection top-to-bottom) — it captures apiKey automatically for every other request via the {{apiKey}} collection variable. Folders '8. Agentic SDLC' and '9. Workflow Orchestrator' need only {{adminKey}} (operator identity). Workflow runs are asynchronous: their poll requests re-run themselves while a run is RUNNING, which works in the Collection Runner and Newman.

item.name: 401 - Root Path (no route defined, denyAll catchall)

exec: // SecurityConfig's catchall changed from permitAll() to denyAll() -- a
// production review correctly flagged permitAll() as a real security gap
// just harmless unmapped paths). With denyAll(), an unmatched route is now
// rejected by Security before it ever reaches the point where
// NoResourceFoundException would produce a 404. The status is 401, not 403:
// this request carries no credential at all, so Spring Security's
// ExceptionTranslationFilter treats the anonymous principal as needing to
// for the full reasoning and the case (a real-but-insufficient credential)
pm.test('status is 401 (denyAll catchall, anonymous caller)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

item.name: 9. Workflow Orchestrator
item.description:
The full SDLC orchestrator (README §13): a 7-stage dependency graph with gates, parallel stages, persistent state, version-bound human approvals, re-planning, isolated git worktrees, audit and metrics. Operator identity only (X-Admin-Key). Runs are ASYNCHRONOUS: the 'poll' requests re-run themselves every 2 s while the run is RUNNING, which works in the Collection Runner and Newman; sent by hand, press Send until it settles.

Flow: create the greenfield click-limit run -> start -> poll to the release checkpoint -> inspect the patch (a DETERMINISTIC_DEMO code recipe: real code, NOT AI), contract, tests, lineage -> a stale decision is refused (409) -> approve the exact readiness version -> promote the patch to a LOCAL branch -> reports, audit, metrics -> amend the requirement (formatting only) and resume: unaffected work is reused and the approval stays valid -> compensate the promotion. Then an ambiguous run stops at the clarification checkpoint and is rejected.

testExecution is PLAN_VERIFICATION here (fast, runs no product tests). Change it to COMMAND to run real 'mvn -o test' in the worktree (1-3 min; needs a warm local Maven repository).
